To Revex (copy Orc): Sol delivered batch A for standard#8 (authorized in issue 6 comment 6933743616), documentation only, branch sol/8-kit-standard from dev 7703d84. Content commit a000821d98d639dec13169a92105c49a62799dd7.

DIRECTIONS restates the accepted kit (autonomy, framework-neutral, required elements, HTML/Docker/.fig as progressive targets, two loading modes, append-only reproducible HTML, preview rule, verification of shipped defaults only, four-step path). CONFIGURATION section 2.1 allows system-declared roles (own defaults, never following another role, unknown elsewhere) and lists Folio's panel, on-panel, panel-accent as a planned declaration, not implemented, awaiting Des. New CHECKLIST and CATALOGUE (Console accepted extraction but kit incomplete; Folio and Marquee not extracted). New template/ with placeholders, Console-derived CONTRIBUTING, MIT LICENSE, A2A placeholders and a structure-only schema. KIT_PROPOSAL gains a decision record; its proposal text is kept.

Checks: 106 local links resolve; template JSON parses and the template defaults, template example and standard example validate against the template schema; git diff --check clean. No change to Console, Folio, Marquee or the frontend; no HTML, Docker, Figma, publication or infrastructure.

To Revex (copy Orc): Sol appended the A-R1 to A-R3 corrections authorized in issue 8 comment 6945488099, on sol/8-kit-standard after a60c8a2, without rewriting. Content commit 6acdaba17811605f24b50a4885519219e56aaa75.

A-R1: template/CONTRIBUTING.md adds review routing by implementing model (Codex including Doc -> Revus, Claude -> Revex), staging validation of the identified version before a separate production GO by midas, and an unavailable staging environment as an unmet gate; exact-HEAD Orc authorization, Rel execution and the separate human, release and deployment gates are kept. A-R2: template/config.schema.json font roles require a non-empty family and a non-empty files array when files is present; omitted roles stay valid; docs/CONFIGURATION.md section 3 aligned. A-R3: template/docs/PROVENANCE.md records CONTRIBUTING's source (wakolab-design-systems-console, CONTRIBUTING.md, 018fe3214e0a118162d202c2f39f1236f37b1936), its adaptations and the template origin; TEMPLATE.md points to it.

Checks: schema valid under Draft 2020-12; three valid font cases pass and Revex's three negative cases plus family with empty files are rejected; template defaults, template example and standard example still validate; links in changed files resolve; git diff --check clean.
